_reasoningEffortOptions: Not a flat field - Claude's real control is output_config.effort: "low" | "medium" | "high" | "xhigh" | "max". Availability/defaults vary by model (e.g. Opus 5.5 supports all 5 and defaults to "medium"; most other current models default to "high" and some don't support "xhigh"/"max"). ApplyRequestShaping.ApplyClaudeEffort moves LLMRequest.reasoningEffort into output_config.effort instead of sending it as reasoning_effort.
